rationale: The plan correctly treats the STAR/featureCounts matrix as raw integer counts fed directly to DESeqDataSetFromMatrix with median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, explicitly rejects tximport/length correction, applies a minimal justified filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples), sets control as the explicit reference with a named treated-vs-control contrast, uses BH at alpha 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage, and states the n=3 power limitation. QC is well specified (blind VST PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes) but only flags an outlier without stating what action follows. Enrichment was not requested; the plan adds it anyway, though the fgsea specification is sound (full ranked list on the Wald statistic, versioned collections, 15-500 size window, BH per collection). The report step names method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/DE counts, diagnostics, and caveats.
